spots.name: Cape Disappointment State Park
spots.tip: Wildlife is most active in the first two hours after sunrise. Stay on trails, use your car as a blind on auto routes and give animals space.

spots.name: Waikiki Beach
spots.tip: Low tide and wet sand give reflections at sunset. Check the tide table and never turn your back on the waves.

spots.name: McKenzie Head
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 63 m (207 ft).

spots.name: Grays Harbor Lighthouse Viewpoint
spots.tip: A mapped viewpoint facing north. Side light at either end of the day. Arrive 30 minutes early to scout foreground.

spots.name: Beards Hollow Overlook
spots.tip: A mapped viewpoint. Check which way it faces: east for sunrise, west for sunset. Arrive 30 minutes early to scout foreground.
